name: Vayusodh Applied Systems and Technologies LLP
india_angle: The company is the first Indian entity providing detailed design support for process utilities in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Vayusodh Applied Systems and Technologies LLP specializes in designing and delivering process utility solutions for semiconductor and photovoltaic industries. They focus on creating high-quality, safe systems for ultra-high purity gases and hazardous chemicals, ensuring compliance with global safety standards.
